title: Classic Romantic Fantasy Creator Returns With New Anime After 11 Years – Watch First Look Trailer
content: The creator behind a classic romantic fantasy anime series is coming back with a new anime after 11 long years, and the first look has been revealed at what fans can expect from the new project.
author: ComicBook

title: Yayū Murata Launches Kickstarter for Across the Strange Edge Manga's 2nd Volume, Deluxe Hardcover Omnibus
content: Yayū Murata announced on Wednesday a Kickstarter project to fund an English version of the second volume of his Across the Strange Edge ( Okashiki Sekai no Kyōkaisen ) series, along with a deluxe hardcover book including the first two volumes and a special cover designed in collaboration with Takashi Kumatani.
author: ANN

title: Shonen Jump Confirms Release Date for Its Next Surprise Live-Action Movie
content: Shueisha’s Weekly Shonen Jump magazine has surprisingly revealed their next major series going to the big screen with a new live-action movie, and has already confirmed its release date for a launch in Japan.
author: ComicBook

title: Sugar Apple Fairy Tale's Miri Mikawa, Brave10's Kairi Shimotsuki Launch New Manga on November 24
content: Shinchosha 's Kurage Bunch website announced on Friday that writer Miri Mikawa and artist Kairi Shimotsuki will launch a new manga titled Ryū no Kuni Gensō (Dragon Country Fantasy) on November 24. The manga is set in Ryū no Hara (Dragon Plains), a realm that safeguards the slumber of dragons.
author: ANN

title: Sakamoto Holidays Manga Heads Towards Climax
content: Tetsu Ōkawa reported on Saturday that the Sakamoto Holidays spinoff manga of Yuuto Suzuki 's Sakamoto Days manga is reaching its climax. Viz Media publishes the series in English and describes the story: Kill some time with former hit man Taro Sakamoto as he solves neighborhood crimes in this spinoff!
author: ANN

title: Reincarnation in the Game World Dan-Katsu Reveals New Trailer Featuring Additional Cast, Theme Songs
content: Reincarnation in the Game World Dan-Katsu: Game Addict Plays “Encouragement for Job Hunting in Dungeons” From a “New Game” anime revealed a new trailer that features four additional cast members. The anime premieres in January 2027.
author: Anime Corner

title: Mashle: Magic and Muscles Live-Action Film Adaptation Announced
content: Hajime Komoto’s Mashle: Magic and Muscles manga is officially getting a live-action film adaptation, with its Japanese theatrical premiere set for March 19, 2027. A super teaser visual was released alongside the announcement, featuring protagonist Mash Burnedead from behind in his school robe while holding a dumbbell…
author: Anime Corner

title: 'Ramen Akeneko 2nd Season' Announces New Staff
content: The official website for the television anime adaptation of Angyaman 's Ramen Akaneko ( Red Cat Ramen ) revealed new staff and key visual (pictured) for the upcoming second season . The anime is scheduled to premiere in January 2027 on Tokyo TV.
author: MyAnimeList

title: Black Clover Season 2 Episode 6 Previews Noelle and Charlotte Facing Vanica
content: Black Clover Season 2 has released preview images and synopsis for Episode 6 (Episode 176 overall) ahead of its November 7 premiere. The new season officially began on October 3, 2026 , with Crunchyroll streaming it worldwide. The anime previously revealed a special Devil Union Asta visual following Episode 3.
author: Anime Corner

title: This Cult Sci-fi Movie Was Roasted by Critics 38 Years Ago, But It Changed Movies, Video Games, and Art Forever
content: There are definitely movies that age badly. And there are films that look even better decades later. Then there’s the rare one that defies all expectations. Imagine a futuristic city filled with neon lights, motorcycle gangs, and enough government corruption to make everybody suspicious.
author: ComicBook
